1: /-

4: Authors: Yaël Dillies
5: -/
6: module
7: 
8: public import Mathlib.Algebra.EuclideanDomain.Int
9: public import Mathlib.Algebra.Module.ZMod
10: public import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dimension.Free
11: 
12: /-!
13: # Quotienting out a free `ℤ`-module
14: 
15: If `G` is a rank `d` free `ℤ`-module, then `G/nG` is a finite group of cardinality `n ^ d`.
16: -/
17: 
18: @[expose] public section
19: 
20: open Finsupp Function Module
21: 
22: variable {G H M : Type*} [AddCommGroup G] {n : ℕ}
23: 
24: variable (G n) in
25: /-- `ModN G n` denotes the quotient of `G` by multiples of `n` -/
26: abbrev ModN : Type _ := G ⧸ LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ G n)
27: 
28: namespace ModN
29: 
30: instance : Module (ZMod n) (ModN G n) := QuotientAddGroup.zmodModule (by simp)
31: 
32: set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
33: /-- The universal property of `ModN G n` in terms of monoids: Monoid homomorphisms from `ModN G n`
34: are the same as monoid homomorphisms from `G` whose values are `n`-torsion. -/
35: protected def liftEquiv [AddMonoid M] : (ModN G n →+ M) ≃ {φ : G →+ M // ∀ g, n • φ g = 0} where
36:   toFun f := ⟨f.comp (QuotientAddGroup.mk' _), fun g ↦ by
37:     let Gn : AddSubgroup G := (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ G n)).toAddSubgroup
38:     suffices n • g ∈ (QuotientAddGroup.mk' Gn).ker by
39:       simp only [AddMonoidHom.coe_comp, comp_apply, ← map_nsmul]
40:       change f (QuotientAddGroup.mk' Gn (n • g)) = 0 -- Can we avoid `change`?
41:       rw [this, map_zero]
42:     simp [QuotientAddGroup.ker_mk', Gn]⟩
43:   invFun φ := QuotientAddGroup.lift _ φ <| by rintro - ⟨g, rfl⟩; simpa using φ.property g
44:   left_inv f := by
45:     ext x
46:     induction x using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on
47:     rfl -- Should `simp` suffice here?
48:   right_inv φ := by aesop
49: 
50: /-- The universal property of `ModN G n` in terms of `ZMod n`-modules: `ZMod n`-linear maps from
51: `ModN G n` are the same as monoid homomorphisms from `G` whose values are `n`-torsion. -/
52: protected def liftEquiv' [AddCommGroup H] [Module (ZMod n) H] :
53:     (ModN G n →ₗ[ZMod n] H) ≃ {φ : G →+ H // ∀ g, n • φ g = 0} :=
54:   (AddMonoidHom.toZModLinearMapEquiv n).symm.toEquiv.trans ModN.liftEquiv
55: 
56: variable (n) in
57: /-- The quotient map `G → G / nG`. -/
58: def mkQ : G →+ ModN G n := (LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ G n)).mkQ
59: 
60: variable [NeZero n]
61: 
62: set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
63: /-- Given a free module `G` over `ℤ`, construct the corresponding basis
64: of `G / ⟨n⟩` over `ℤ / nℤ`. -/
65: noncomputable def basis {ι : Type*} (b : Basis ι ℤ G) : Basis ι (ZMod n) (ModN G n) := by
66:   set ψ : G →+ G := zsmulAddGroupHom n
67:   set nG := LinearMap.range (LinearMap.lsmul ℤ G n)
68:   set H := G ⧸ nG
69:   set φ : G →ₗ[ℤ] H := nG.mkQ
70:   let mod : (ι →₀ ℤ) →ₗ[ℤ] (ι →₀ ZMod n) := mapRange.linearMap (Int.castAddHom _).toIntLinearMap
71:   let f : G →ₗ[ℤ] (ι →₀ ℤ) := b.repr
72:   have hker : nG ≤ LinearMap.ker (mod.comp f) := by
73:     rintro _ ⟨x, rfl⟩
74:     ext b
75:     simp [mod, f]
76:   let g : H →ₗ[ℤ] (ι →₀ ZMod n) := nG.liftQ (mod.comp f) hker
77:   refine ⟨.ofBijective (g.toAddMonoidHom.toZModLinearMap n) ⟨?_, ?_⟩⟩
78:   · rw [AddMonoidHom.coe_toZModLinearMap, LinearMap.toAddMonoidHom_coe, injective_iff_map_eq_zero,
79:       nG.mkQ_surjective.forall]
80:     intro x hx
81:     simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply, g] at hx
82:     rw [Submodule.liftQ_apply] at hx
83:     replace hx : ∀ b, ↑n ∣ f x b := by
84:       simpa [mod, DFunLike.ext_iff, ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd] using! hx
85:     simp only [Submodule.mkQ_apply]
86:     rw [Submodule.Quotient.mk_eq_zero]
87:     choose c hc using hx
88:     refine ⟨b.repr.symm ⟨(f x).support, c, by simp [hc, NeZero.ne]⟩, b.repr.injective ?_⟩
89:     simpa [DFunLike.ext_iff, eq_comm] using! hc
90:   · suffices mod ∘ b.repr = g ∘ nG.mkQ by
91:       exact (this ▸ (mapRange_surjective _ (map_zero _) ZMod.intCast_surjective).comp
92:         b.repr.surjective).of_comp
93:     ext x b
94:     simp [mod, g, f, H]
95: 
96: set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false in
97: lemma basis_apply_eq_mkQ {ι : Type*} (b : Basis ι ℤ G) (i : ι) : basis b i = mkQ n (b i) := by
98:   rw [Basis.apply_eq_iff]; simp [basis, mkQ]
99: 
100: variable [Module.Free ℤ G] [Module.Finite ℤ G]
101: 
102: instance instModuleFinite : Module.Finite (ZMod n) (ModN G n) :=
103:   .of_basis <| basis <| Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ G
104: 
105: instance instFinite : Finite (ModN G n) := Module.finite_of_finite (ZMod n)
106: 
107: variable (G n)
108: @[simp] lemma natCard_eq : Nat.card (ModN G n) = n ^ Module.finrank ℤ G := by
109:   simp [Nat.card_congr (basis <| Module.Free.chooseBasis ℤ G).repr.toEquiv,
110:     Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Module.finrank_eq_card_chooseBasisIndex]
111:

72: To reason about the localization as a quotient type, use `mk_eq_of_mk'` and associated lemmas.
73: These show the quotient map `mk : R → M → Localization M` equals the surjection
74: `LocalizationMap.mk'` induced by the map `algebraMap : R →+* Localization M`.

79: is a field" is a `def` rather than an `instance`, so if you want to reason about a field of
80: fractions `K`, assume `[Field K]` instead of just `[CommRing K]`.

95: variable {R : Type*} [CommSemiring R] (M : Submonoid R) (S : Type*) [CommSemiring S]

98: /-- An auxiliary typeclass to avoid auto-generated declarations
99: under the `IsLocalization` namespace. -/
100: class IsLocalization' : Prop extends M.IsLocalizationMap (algebraMap R S)
101: 
102: /-- The typeclass `IsLocalization (M : Submonoid R) S` where `S` is an `R`-algebra
103: expresses that `S` is isomorphic to the localization of `R` at `M`. -/
104: abbrev IsLocalization := @IsLocalization'
105: 
106: theorem isLocalization_iff_isLocalizationMap :
107:     IsLocalization M S ↔ M.IsLocalizationMap (algebraMap R S) :=
108:   ⟨fun ⟨h⟩ ↦ h, fun h ↦ ⟨h⟩⟩
109: 
110: theorem isLocalization_iff : IsLocalization M S ↔
111:     (∀ y : M, IsUnit (algebraMap R S y)) ∧
112:     (∀ z : S, ∃ x : R × M, z * algebraMap R S x.2 = algebraMap R S x.1) ∧
113:     ∀ {x y : R}, algebraMap R S x = algebraMap R S y → ∃ c : M, c * x = c * y := by
114:   rw [isLocalization_iff_isLocalizationMap, Submonoid.isLocalizationMap_iff]

117: 
118: namespace IsLocalization
119:

121:

123: 
124: section

126: /-- Everything in the image of `algebraMap` is a unit. -/
127: theorem map_units : ∀ y : M, IsUnit (algebraMap R S y) :=
128:   IsLocalization'.toIsLocalizationMap.map_units
129: 
130: variable (M) {S}
131: /-- Every element in the localization can be expressed as a quotient of an element in the
132: range of `algebraMap` by the image of an element of the submonoid. -/
133: theorem surj : ∀ z : S, ∃ x : R × M, z * algebraMap R S x.2 = algebraMap R S x.1 :=
134:   IsLocalization'.toIsLocalizationMap.surj

138:   IsLocalization'.toIsLocalizationMap.exists_of_eq

143: theorem smul_bijective (m : M) : Bijective fun s : S ↦ m • s := by
144:   simpa only [Submonoid.smul_def, Algebra.smul_def] using! (map_units S m).smul_bijective

146: /-- `IsLocalization.toLocalizationMap M S` shows `S` is the monoid localization of `R` at `M`. -/
147: abbrev toLocalizationMap : M.LocalizationMap S where

∀ red : Reduction.loc p →+* ZMod p,
  (∀ (a d : ℤ), ¬ (p : ℤ) ∣ d → ∀ r : Reduction.loc p,
    (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ) / (d : ℚ) → red r * (d : ZMod p) = (a : ZMod p)) →
  ∀ (r : Reduction.loc p) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    ModN.mkQ p (r • u) = red r • ModN.mkQ p u
arguments.proof:
intro red hred r u
letI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨h_H001⟩
obtain ⟨a,d,hd,he⟩ := (h_T004.1.1 r.val).mp r.property
have hd0 : (d : ℚ) ≠ 0 := by
  exact_mod_cast (show d ≠ 0 from fun hz => hd (hz ▸ dvd_zero _))
have hr : (d : Reduction.loc p) * r = (a : Reduction.loc p) := by
  apply Subtype.ext
  change (d : ℚ) * (r : ℚ) = (a : ℚ)
  rw [he, mul_div_cancel₀ _ hd0]
have hdZ : (d : ZMod p) ≠ 0 := (ZMod.intCast_zmod_eq_zero_iff_dvd d p).not.mpr hd
apply (smul_left_cancel₀ hdZ)
rw [smul_smul, mul_comm (d : ZMod p), hred a d hd r he]
calc
  (d : ZMod p) • ModN.mkQ p (r • u) =
      ModN.mkQ p (d • (r • u)) := by simp
  _ = ModN.mkQ p ((a : Reduction.loc p) • u) := by
    congr 1
    rw [← Int.cast_smul_eq_zsmul (Reduction.loc p), smul_smul, hr]
  _ = (a : ZMod p) • ModN.mkQ p u := by simp

arguments.statement:
∀ (red : Reduction.loc p →+* ZMod p)
 (eps : ZMod p →+* K),
 (∀ (r : Reduction.loc p) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    ModN.mkQ p (r • u) = red r • ModN.mkQ p u) →
 letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
 letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
 ∃ Psi : (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) ≃ₗ[K]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p),
 (∀ (c : K) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    Psi (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u) = c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) ∧
 (∀ (c : K) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    Psi.symm (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) = c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u)
arguments.proof:
intro red eps hq
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
let q : Reduction.MR p M →ₗ[Reduction.loc p]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p) :=
  { toFun := fun u => 1 ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u
    map_add' := by intro u v; simp [TensorProduct.tmul_add]
    map_smul' := by
      intro r u
      dsimp
      rw [hq, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      rfl }
let fw := q.liftBaseChange K
let g : Reduction.MR p M →+ (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  (TensorProduct.mk (Reduction.loc p) K (Reduction.MR p M) 1).toAddMonoidHom
have hg : ∀ u, p • g u = 0 := by
  intro u
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, CharP.cast_eq_zero K p, zero_smul]
let t : ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p →ₗ[ZMod p]
    (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  ModN.liftEquiv'.symm ⟨g,hg⟩
have ht : ∀ u, t (ModN.mkQ p u) = 1 ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u := fun u => rfl
let bw := t.liftBaseChange K
have hfw : ∀ c u, fw (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u) =
    c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u := by
  intro c u
  simp [fw, q, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
have hbw : ∀ c u, bw (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) =
    c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u := by
  intro c u
  simp [bw, ht, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
have hbf : bw.comp fw = LinearMap.id := by
  ext c u
  simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfw, hbw]
have hfb : fw.comp bw = LinearMap.id := by
  ext c u
  induction u using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H u => simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfw, hbw]
let Psi := LinearEquiv.ofLinear fw bw hfb hbf
exact ⟨Psi, hfw, hbw⟩

∀ (red : Reduction.loc p →+* ZMod p)
 (eps : ZMod p →+* K),
 (∀ (r : Reduction.loc p) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    ModN.mkQ p (r • u) = red r • ModN.mkQ p u) →
 letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
 letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
 ∃ Psi : (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) ≃ₗ[K]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p),
 (∀ (c : K) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    Psi (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u) = c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) ∧
 (∀ (c : K) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    Psi.symm (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) = c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u)
result.proof:
intro red eps hq
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
let q : Reduction.MR p M →ₗ[Reduction.loc p]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p) :=
  { toFun := fun u => 1 ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u
    map_add' := by intro u v; simp [TensorProduct.tmul_add]
    map_smul' := by
      intro r u
      dsimp
      rw [hq, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      rfl }
let fw := q.liftBaseChange K
let g : Reduction.MR p M →+ (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  (TensorProduct.mk (Reduction.loc p) K (Reduction.MR p M) 1).toAddMonoidHom
have hg : ∀ u, p • g u = 0 := by
  intro u
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, CharP.cast_eq_zero K p, zero_smul]
let t : ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p →ₗ[ZMod p]
    (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  ModN.liftEquiv'.symm ⟨g,hg⟩
have ht : ∀ u, t (ModN.mkQ p u) = 1 ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u := fun u => rfl
let bw := t.liftBaseChange K
have hfw : ∀ c u, fw (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u) =
    c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u := by
  intro c u
  simp [fw, q, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
have hbw : ∀ c u, bw (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) =
    c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u := by
  intro c u
  simp [bw, ht, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
have hbf : bw.comp fw = LinearMap.id := by
  ext c u
  simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfw, hbw]
have hfb : fw.comp bw = LinearMap.id := by
  ext c u
  induction u using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H u => simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfw, hbw]
let Psi := LinearEquiv.ofLinear fw bw hfb hbf
exact ⟨Psi, hfw, hbw⟩

∀ (red : Reduction.loc p →+* ZMod p)
 (eps : ZMod p →+* K),
 (∀ (r : Reduction.loc p) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    ModN.mkQ p (r • u) = red r • ModN.mkQ p u) →
 letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
 letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
 ∃ Psi : (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) ≃ₗ[K]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p),
 (∀ (c : K) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    Psi (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u) = c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) ∧
 (∀ (c : K) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    Psi.symm (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) = c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u)
arguments.proof:
intro red eps hq
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
let q : Reduction.MR p M →ₗ[Reduction.loc p]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p) :=
  { toFun := fun u => 1 ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u
    map_add' := by intro u v; simp [TensorProduct.tmul_add]
    map_smul' := by
      intro r u
      dsimp
      rw [hq, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      rfl }
let fw := q.liftBaseChange K
let g : Reduction.MR p M →+ (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  (TensorProduct.mk (Reduction.loc p) K (Reduction.MR p M) 1).toAddMonoidHom
have hg : ∀ u, p • g u = 0 := by
  intro u
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, CharP.cast_eq_zero K p, zero_smul]
let t : ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p →ₗ[ZMod p]
    (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  ModN.liftEquiv'.symm ⟨g,hg⟩
have ht : ∀ u, t (ModN.mkQ p u) = 1 ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u := fun u => rfl
let bw := t.liftBaseChange K
have hfw : ∀ c u, fw (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u) =
    c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u := by
  intro c u
  simp [fw, q, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
have hbw : ∀ c u, bw (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) =
    c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u := by
  intro c u
  simp [bw, ht, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
have hbf : bw.comp fw = LinearMap.id := by
  ext c u
  simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfw, hbw]
have hfb : fw.comp bw = LinearMap.id := by
  ext u
  induction u using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H u => simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfw, hbw]
let Psi := LinearEquiv.ofLinear fw bw hfb hbf
exact ⟨Psi, hfw, hbw⟩

∀ (red : Reduction.loc p →+* ZMod p)
 (eps : ZMod p →+* K),
 (∀ (r : Reduction.loc p) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    ModN.mkQ p (r • u) = red r • ModN.mkQ p u) →
 letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
 letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
 ∃ Psi : (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) ≃ₗ[K]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p),
 (∀ (c : K) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    Psi (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u) = c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) ∧
 (∀ (c : K) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    Psi.symm (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) = c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u)
arguments.proof:
intro red eps hq
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
let q : Reduction.MR p M →ₗ[Reduction.loc p]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p) :=
  { toFun := fun u => 1 ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u
    map_add' := by intro u v; simp [TensorProduct.tmul_add]
    map_smul' := by
      intro r u
      dsimp
      rw [hq, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      rfl }
let fw := q.liftBaseChange K
let g : Reduction.MR p M →+ (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  (TensorProduct.mk (Reduction.loc p) K (Reduction.MR p M) 1).toAddMonoidHom
have hg : ∀ u, p • g u = 0 := by
  intro u
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, CharP.cast_eq_zero K p, zero_smul]
let t : ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p →ₗ[ZMod p]
    (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  ModN.liftEquiv'.symm ⟨g,hg⟩
have ht : ∀ u, t (ModN.mkQ p u) = 1 ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u := fun u => rfl
let bw := t.liftBaseChange K
have hfw : ∀ c u, fw (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u) =
    c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u := by
  intro c u
  simp [fw, q, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
have hbw : ∀ c u, bw (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) =
    c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u := by
  intro c u
  simp [bw, ht, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
have hbf : bw.comp fw = LinearMap.id := by
  ext c u
  simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfw, hbw]
have hfb : fw.comp bw = LinearMap.id := by
  ext u
  induction u using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H u =>
    change fw (bw (1 ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u)) = 1 ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u
    rw [hbw, hfw]
let Psi := LinearEquiv.ofLinear fw bw hfb hbf
exact ⟨Psi, hfw, hbw⟩

arguments.statement:
∀ (red : Reduction.loc p →+* ZMod p)
 (eps : ZMod p →+* K),
 (∀ (r : Reduction.loc p) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    ModN.mkQ p (r • u) = red r • ModN.mkQ p u) →
 letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
 letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
 ∃ Psi : (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) ≃ₗ[K]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p),
 (∀ (c : K) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    Psi (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u) = c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) ∧
 (∀ (c : K) (u : Reduction.MR p M),
    Psi.symm (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) = c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u)
arguments.proof:
intro red eps hq
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := (eps.comp red).toAlgebra
letI : Algebra (ZMod p) K := eps.toAlgebra
let q : Reduction.MR p M →ₗ[Reduction.loc p]
    (K ⊗[ZMod p] ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p) :=
  { toFun := fun u => 1 ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u
    map_add' := by intro u v; simp [TensorProduct.tmul_add]
    map_smul' := by
      intro r u
      dsimp
      rw [hq, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul, ← TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
      rfl }
let fw := q.liftBaseChange K
let g : Reduction.MR p M →+ (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  (TensorProduct.mk (Reduction.loc p) K (Reduction.MR p M) 1).toAddMonoidHom
have hg : ∀ u, p • g u = 0 := by
  intro u
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul K, CharP.cast_eq_zero K p, zero_smul]
let t : ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p →ₗ[ZMod p]
    (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  ModN.liftEquiv'.symm ⟨g,hg⟩
have ht : ∀ u, t (ModN.mkQ p u) = 1 ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u := fun u => rfl
let bw := t.liftBaseChange K
have hfw : ∀ c u, fw (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u) =
    c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u := by
  intro c u
  simp [fw, q, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
have hbw : ∀ c u, bw (c ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u) =
    c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] u := by
  intro c u
  simp [bw, ht, TensorProduct.smul_tmul']
have hbf : bw.comp fw = LinearMap.id := by
  ext c u
  simp [LinearMap.comp_apply, hfw, hbw]
have hfb : fw.comp bw = LinearMap.id := by
  ext u
  induction u using QuotientAddGroup.induction_on with
  | H u =>
    change fw (bw (1 ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u)) = 1 ⊗ₜ[ZMod p] ModN.mkQ p u
    rw [hbw, hfw]
obtain ⟨Psi, hPsi, hPsis⟩ :=
  @yui_aux_0006 p l K fieldK V addV modV act x y h v0 M h_H001 h_H002 h_H003 h_T004
    red eps fw bw hfb hbf
refine ⟨Psi, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro c u
  change Psi.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [hPsi, hfw]
· intro c u
  change Psi.symm.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [hPsis, hbw]

∀ bar : Reduction.loc p →+* K,
 letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra
 ∃ Phi : Reduction.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M),
 (∀ (c : K) (m : M), Phi (c ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m) = c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] (1 ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) ∧
 (∀ (c : K) (s : Reduction.loc p) (m : M),
   Phi.symm (c ⊗ₜ[Reduction.loc p] (s ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)) = (c * bar s) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m)
arguments.proof:
intro bar
letI : Algebra (Reduction.loc p) K := bar.toAlgebra
let Phi : Reduction.VK K M ≃ₗ[K] (K ⊗[Reduction.loc p] Reduction.MR p M) :=
  (TensorProduct.AlgebraTensorModule.cancelBaseChange ℤ (Reduction.loc p) K K M).symm
refine ⟨Phi, ?_, ?_⟩
· intro c m
  rfl
· intro c s m
  change (s • c) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m = (c * bar s) ⊗ₜ[ℤ] m
  simp [Algebra.smul_def, mul_comm]
